init_ddp_process_group: initialize the PyTorch DDP process group using nccl backend with auto-detected distributed spec
get_distributed_spec: get the current distributed setup info including rank, world size, local rank, and node count
set_distrib_env: set distributed environment variables like MASTER_ADDR, MASTER_PORT, WORLD_SIZE, RANK, and LOCAL_RANK
check_is_master: check if the current process is the master process with rank equal to zero
get_world_size: get the current world size of the distributed process group or return one if not initialized
